newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai offshore bank loans down in Sept over August.
newsitem.headline: Thai offshore bank loans down in Sept over August.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Monday outstanding loans extended by offshore banking units fell to 1,262.3 billion baht ($50.48 billion) at end-September from 1,268.5 billion baht the previous month.
The loans are made through the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF).
The central bank said the loans brought in by commecial banks for relending to domestic borrowers rose 0.4 percent to 773.8 billion baht at the end of September from 770.8 billion at end-August.

Cumulative foreign loans handled by offshore banking units here for third country borrowers amounted to 488.5 billion baht at the end-September, down from 497.7 billion baht at the end of previous month.
